	title = "EVTNAME24847"
	desc = "EVTDESC24847"
	trigger = {
		controlled_by_rebels = yes
		NOT = {
			is_core = PER
		}
		any_neighbor_province = {
			is_core = PER
		}
		any_pop = {
			has_pop_culture = azerbaijani
		}
		owner = {
			NOT = {
				tag = PER
			}
			PER = {
				OR = {
					accepted_culture = azerbaijani
					primary_culture = azerbaijani
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 4
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA24847"
		add_core = PER
	}
}

	title = "EVTNAME24906"
	desc = "EVTDESC24906"
	trigger = {
		controlled_by_rebels = yes
		NOT = {
			is_core = UAE
		}
		any_neighbor_province = {
			is_core = UAE
		}
		any_pop = {
			has_pop_culture = bedouin
		}
		owner = {
			NOT = {
				tag = UAE
			}
			UAE = {
				OR = {
					accepted_culture = bedouin
					primary_culture = bedouin
				}
			}
		}
	}
	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 4
	}
	option = {
		name = "EVTOPTA24906"
		add_core = UAE
	}
}
